check_order_rationale: VALIDITY FIRST, and this ordering is not cosmetic. Run 1 of the parent arm emitted its STRONGEST verdict while a validity gate was failing, because that gate's predicate could never fire. Every indeterminate is evaluated before every substantive outcome, and each outcome is required to be reachable by some constructed input (pinned by test).

feasibility_established_first.pos_control_note: All 106 pos_control rows are 48-75 bp, so the STRONGEST positive control is unavailable in the native-150 cell. Padding is refused: measured to perturb this encoder's pooled embedding. This NARROWS what the experiment can show and is a recorded limit, not a worked-around one.

forecast.note: Scored after the run. My forecast record in this project is 2 of 6 and the errors have been PESSIMISTIC -- the measured bias is that I talk the project out of runs that then succeed. Do not defer to these priors; they are recorded to be scored.
forecast.reasoning: Separability should be high -- tiles come from called peaks, controls are random or negative genomic sequence, and the encoder was pretrained on exactly the upstream regions peaks sit in. But removing ONE direction leaves 127, and promoter-STRENGTH information need not lie along the detection axis, so a total collapse is the less likely branch.

honest_limits_fixed_in_advance: Linear removal only; a nonlinear detection signal survives it.
1,406 controls against 44,106 tiles, and the control medians (0.3502 / 0.3370) sit close to the tile median (0.4338), so weak separability could reflect the controls.
pos_control is geometry-incompatible, so the strongest positive control is absent.
One rung, one organism, 10 seeds. Nothing here speaks to any other rung.
The paired restatement against the conv channel is NOT available locally -- only the atlas per-tile predictions were cached, so the comparator here is the GC anchor.
A confirmed extraction RULE is not a proven provenance chain to the exact trained h5; see what_this_does_NOT_establish in the provenance artifact.
inherited_margin_source: wiki/promoteratlas_arm_acceptance_bar.json (the 0.02 margin the arm was graded on)

EXPOSURE_EXCLUDED_LINEAR.meaning: The gain survives linear removal essentially intact. BOUNDED BY CONSTRUCTION -- see pre_commitments[1].
EXPOSURE_EXCLUDED_LINEAR.predicate: drop from removing the separation direction <= 0.02

EXPOSURE_EXPLAINS.meaning: The encoder's advantage over the dumb baseline does not survive removing the detection direction. The 0.5076 was substantially promoter DETECTION.
EXPOSURE_EXPLAINS.predicate: surviving median (atlas minus separation direction) - gc median < 0.02

EXPOSURE_PARTIAL.meaning: A material, quantified discount. The honest limit becomes a number.
EXPOSURE_PARTIAL.predicate: drop from removing the separation direction > 0.02 AND surviving margin over gc >= 0.02

INDETERMINATE_CONTROLS_UNSEPARABLE.meaning: If a cheap feature cannot separate the controls either, then 'the encoder cannot separate them' is a statement about the CONTROLS, not the encoder.

INDETERMINATE_HARNESS_DRIFT.meaning: No exposure claim may rest on a harness that cannot reproduce the published number. Diagnose the harness; do NOT widen the tolerance.
INDETERMINATE_HARNESS_DRIFT.predicate: the local harness fails to reproduce gc.seed0 within 0.01, gc.median within 0.01, or atlas.native150 within 0.02

INDETERMINATE_REMOVAL_COST_UNBOUNDED.meaning: Then a drop under A2 cannot be attributed to the separation direction specifically, and the cell measures the cost of projection itself.
INDETERMINATE_REMOVAL_COST_UNBOUNDED.predicate: median drop from removing a RANDOM direction > 0.02, i.e. removing ANY single direction of 128 already costs more than the margin

pre_commitments.name: non_vacuity_of_the_control
pre_commitments.text: The controls must be separable by a cheap feature (GC) before 'the encoder cannot separate them' may be read as a finding. If the separating direction is unidentifiable, the response is MORE CONTROL SEQUENCES, never a weaker control.

pre_commitments.name: exclusion_is_linear_only
pre_commitments.text: Direction removal is a LINEAR operation, so a nonlinear detection signal survives it. EXPOSURE_EXCLUDED_LINEAR therefore may NEVER be written up as 'exposure excluded', in this or any downstream document.

pre_commitments.name: a_measured_metric_is_not_retro_edited
pre_commitments.text: On EXPOSURE_EXPLAINS or EXPOSURE_PARTIAL, the arm's recorded arms.native150 = 0.5076 KEEPS its measured value. The discount lives in the honest limit, which is upgraded from an unquantified 'not excluded' to a number. A measured metric is not edited to match a later finding.

pre_commitments.name: no_float_dump_into_the_wiki_tree
pre_commitments.text: Per-sequence vectors and per-tile predictions go to gitignored data/promoteratlas/. wiki/ is the DECOY POOL scripts/contract_number_audit.py uses, and a 102,755-decimal dump broke two of its guards on 2026-11-01.

question: Is arms.native150 = 0.5076 substantially promoter DETECTION rather than promoter-strength prediction? The pretraining corpus is 200 bp immediately upstream of each annotated gene start (measured from the authors' own extract_promoter_regions; see wiki/promoteratlas_corpus_provenance_2026-11-01.json), so 'resembles the corpus' is a proxy for 'is a real regulatory region', which correlates with measured expression.
why_this_is_not_an_authority_call: Every threshold is inherited (the 0.02 margin) or committed (the GC floor, the atlas median, the GC tolerance). Nothing redefines the parent arm's acceptance bar, and the parent arm's recorded metric is explicitly preserved by pre_commitments[2].
